items.context: Prefix of every machine account Ares adds with impacket-addcomputer: ARES- plus 8 uppercase hex digits and a trailing $, password Ar<16 hex>!7z; the name is minted in code whatever the model asks for (privesc/delegation.rs:362-378). Match the full pattern ^ARES-[0-9A-F]{8}\$$, not the prefix alone
